assertions.label: uint32 limit >255 cannot be reached by u8 after

constructor_selected_limit.scope: Verified local constructor paths; not a global exclusion of all other writers.

caller_frame.note: Frame envelope equals previous write-derived lower bound; not a C sizeof proof.

cfg.scope: Overapproximate intraprocedural graph for modeled switch indices; calls assumed to return and preserve r7 under normal ABI. No callee, interrupt or path-feasibility proof.

counter_model.rule: c=(old+1)&255; complete=(c >= M32[O+0x37a0]) || (M8[O+0x3d9a]!=0). If complete: M8[O+0x1c08]=0; M8[O+0x378e]=1; M8[O]=6. Below threshold and zero bypass branches to 0x08016ca2.
counter_model.note: Conditional path and selected input combinations, not measured event rate or hardware timing.

limitations: Object identity holds for the selected caller and normal register preservation; external runtime modification not observed.
Count unit, threshold producer, bypass meaning and payload completion semantics still require callers/consumers.
State values outside modeled 0..6, computed entries and non-returning/ABI-violating calls are not proven safe.
